newsitem.title: USA: AMEX starts trading NatWest energy index options.
newsitem.headline: AMEX starts trading NatWest energy index options.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange (AMEX) said Tuesday it started trading options on the NatWest Energy Index .NEX.

The options opened with strike prices in five-point intervals between 235 and 315. At about 1000 CDT/1500 GMT, the index, which is composed of 30 companies involved in domestic and international oil, natural gas exploration and production, oil services, equipment and manufacturing, drilling and refining, was up 0.48 at 271.32.
Initial expirations have been set for June, July, August, September and December. Timber Hill Inc is the specialist.
